concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-manage-balance-accounts]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace Configuration API/Customer Area guide for user balance-account creation, lookup, update and permanent zero-balance closure; account-holder deactivation is separate.
warnings: Permanent closure requires an empty balance account; the guide routes remaining funds to payout or transfer before status `Closed`, without demonstrating those funds moved.
A sample `active` response or API resource creation does not establish completed onboarding, verification or live capability.
